# bioconductor-motifdb

## Overview

Use the Bioconductor R package **MotifDb** for: the package is available on all platforms; click for details.

## Installation

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("MotifDb")
```
